name: Will Palm
description: Drive an open palm forward with the whole mind fixed on one point so the blow lands without a wasted motion.

name: Will Guard
description: Fix the mind on the incoming blow and brace both forearms so the qi hardens exactly where it lands.

name: Will Step
description: Plant the intent three paces ahead and cross the ground in one smooth step toward it.

name: Fixed Pulse
description: Push a short pulse of intent from the brow that thumps the target's chest like the shove of a hand.

name: Steady Hand
description: Rest a hand on an ally's shoulder and lend a steady will that stills shaking limbs and clears a frightened head.

name: Level Gaze
description: Fix a hard unblinking look on the opponent so the next movement falters for a breath.

name: Quiet Breath
description: Draw one slow breath and hold the will behind it so the user's own trembling limbs grow still.

name: Resolve Fist
description: Punch straight ahead with a refusal to stop behind the fist so the blow keeps driving after it lands.

name: Resolve Guard
description: Set both arms across the body and refuse the blow so a layer of hardened qi gathers where it would strike.

name: Resolve Step
description: Advance a long pace without pause as though nothing in the way had the right to slow the body.

name: Firm Heel
description: Dig the back heel in and turn a heavy push aside along the line of the planted leg.

name: Rally Word
description: Speak one short word of resolve to a flagging ally and let the will behind it lift their tired arms.

name: Stubborn Shove
description: Lean a stubborn shoulder into the opponent so the stance is pushed apart and the next blow is lost.

name: Vow Strike
description: Speak a short vow under the breath and strike so the blow carries the weight of the promise.

name: Vowbound Shield
description: Swear to take no harm and raise a thin film of will-hardened qi over the front of the body.

name: Vowbound Pace
description: Swear to arrive and take one long bound that the body keeps because the vow was spoken.

name: Oathbound Palm
description: Press an open palm onto the target while holding the vow aloud until the force has fully passed through.

name: Sworn Brace
description: Hold a sworn stance and let the vow keep the arms hard against each blow for as long as it is spoken.

name: Vow Spur
description: Speak a vow beside a wavering ally so the promise lends them a surge of nerve and strength.

name: Vow Listen
description: Speak a vow of attention and feel from the answering silence which nearby minds mean harm.

name: Spoken Weight
description: Say a flat word of command so the opponent's breath catches and their qi sinks for a moment.

name: Intent Jab
description: Snap a straight jab along the exact line the intent has drawn so it cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Intent Block
description: Meet a swing with a forearm held by pure intent and slide its force aside along the bone.

name: Intent Glide
description: Slide forward on a single held intent with the knees soft and the head level.

name: Unwavering Aim
description: Throw a small lump of will-hardened qi that flies true because the mind never leaves the target.

name: Intent Read
description: Hold still and feel from the set of a stranger's shoulders which way their intent is about to turn.

name: Intent Lend
description: Lend a portion of the user's steady intent to an ally so their hands stop wandering from the task.

name: Unmoved Stance
description: Plant both feet and hold a will that will not be moved so a weight of qi sets through the legs.

name: Unmoved Palm
description: Strike from the rooted stance without shifting the feet so the whole weight of the standing body follows.

name: Anchored Step
description: Move one foot at a time and keep the other fixed so that the body is never caught mid-stride.

name: Rooted Brace
description: Lock the knees and the spine at the instant of impact so a heavy blow breaks against the whole frame.

name: Stand Fast
description: Stand beside an ally and share the will to hold until both of them stop being pushed back.

name: Turned Shove
description: Take a shove on the unmoving torso and turn its force down the hip and out through the heel.

name: Stilled Fear
description: Lay a calm hand on a frightened ally and push the will to stand into their chest until the shaking stops.

name: Purpose Strike
description: Throw one blow at the chosen mark with the whole body in service of that one purpose.

name: Purpose Guard
description: Hold up only the one guard that the purpose requires and harden it until it rings.

name: Purpose Dash
description: Run a short straight dash toward the chosen mark with nothing in the mind but the goal.

name: Fixed Stare
description: Hold a fixed hard stare on the opponent until their attention snags on it and their guard drops.

name: Purpose Share
description: Name the goal aloud to an ally and share the will to reach it until their effort steadies.

name: Sharp Command
description: Bark one short order at the opponent so that the body obeys for half a breath and loses its balance.

name: Bidding Fist
description: Throw a fist that does exactly what the will bids and lands where the eye was told to look.

name: Command Ward
description: Order the qi to stand in front of the body and let it harden at the word.

name: Quick Bidding
description: Bid the legs to go and cross a short gap at the instant of the word.

name: Barked Order
description: Shout a flat order into the opponent's face so their qi sinks and their next move comes slow.

name: Order Echo
description: Repeat a single order to nearby allies so they act together on the same breath.

name: Command Sense
description: Send a quiet order outward and feel which listeners answer with a flinch or a tightened breath.

name: Calm Order
description: Give a gentle command to a panicked ally and let the will inside it slow the racing heart.

name: Insistent Push
description: Press both palms forward and keep pressing without any haste until the target gives up the ground.

name: Insistent Guard
description: Hold a patient guard that never moves yet never tires while the will keeps asking the blows to stop.

name: Insistent Step
description: Step forward in a calm even pace that does not hurry and does not stop.

name: Gentle Weight
description: Lay a quiet pressure of will on the opponent's shoulders until their qi feels heavy and slow.

name: Patient Press
description: Lean a slow palm into the target and let the unhurried weight of the body finish the blow.

name: Quiet Rally
description: Murmur an unhurried word to a tired ally and lend them the will to keep on to the end.

name: Slow Listen
description: Stay silent and still and read the wish of a nearby person from the way they hold their breath.
